title.html: A small surface. A distinct identity.

body.html: A coaster places a precise accent beneath the glass. At this small scale, outline, grain, edge and branding become immediately apparent. Round Ø 100 mm and square 100 × 100 mm are the classic starting sizes. A Ø 130 mm bottle coaster and 350 × 110 mm conference coaster provide related formats. Each organises a different situation: a single glass, a bottle, or several glasses in a meeting or banqueting setting. Colour and finish can echo a placemat, tray or menu cover, creating a quiet connection across the table. The object remains small, yet repetition throughout a room gives it a noticeable presence.

Plan with the glasses and bottles actually used rather than a nominal measurement alone. Base diameter, condensation, location and the way staff clear the table all belong in the sample review. Underside and care are agreed for the specific surface; they do not imply a general performance promise. Branding artwork is assessed at actual size. Fine marks need sufficient distance from edge and stitching to retain composure on the small field. For a conference coaster, also establish which glasses are intended to sit together. The drinks mat becomes a practical tabletop accessory whose proportions and identity respond precisely to its setting.
For bar, guest room and meeting areas, record glass type, format and item reference separately. The common material language remains visible while the right coaster reaches the intended setting.

body.html: Choose from genuine Italian leather, high-quality PU and other materials available for the product. We use samples to agree colour, finish and construction for your accessory.
Blind debossing presses the design into the surface without colour. Foil stamping adds a coloured or metallic finish. We agree the method, size and position to suit the material.

body.html: A few answers before our first conversation.

faq.q: Can you develop a custom shape or size?

a.html: Yes. We discuss custom dimensions and original designs for the selected accessory. A sketch, a photograph of the setting or dimensions of the objects to be accommodated help translate your idea into a reviewable specification.

faq.q: How do we agree the material and branding?

a.html: We discuss colour, finish and operating conditions. Material samples and artwork showing logo placement support the selection. Blind debossing, foil stamping and other methods depend on the material and accessory.

faq.q: What does SFP need for a quotation?

a.html: Tell us the accessory or idea, quantity needed, required date and main design preferences. One-offs and very small runs are welcome, and our offer also covers large projects. We agree the specification and timing around your needs. The project planner helps you bring the details together.

body.html: Choose an individual accessory as your starting point. Specify materials, dimensions and details separately for every item in your enquiry.

Glass and bottle coasters protect table surfaces and carry a restaurant or bar’s material scheme through to each place setting. Genuine leather, PU leather and felt are available, in round, square, oval and other shapes. Dimensions, corners, decorative stitching and branding are specified to suit the glassware, bottles and overall table setting.

media.alt: Coasters — product photograph with an edited setting

body.html: Banquet coasters protect conference tables beneath glasses and bottles and can be coordinated with matching desk pads. The 350 × 110 mm starting size can be made single- or double-sided and adapted to custom dimensions. Bottle recesses, square or rounded corners, decorative stitching and branding organise drinks and reinforce the material scheme at each place.

body.html: Production can take 4–6 weeks after your approval. We agree the specific delivery date with you.
Where the product, materials and capacity allow, express orders are available for a surcharge, with delivery potentially in under two weeks. We confirm feasibility before you place the order.
For new customers, we request 100% payment in advance. For large orders from existing customers, we request a 50% advance payment. The agreed terms are set out in your quotation.
